scope: Per-card comparison-only frame normalization; independent disjoint outer-frame fit/validation strips. Translation/uniform scale, then validated rotation and bounded global shear. No symbol/text/art anchors, no independent axis stretch or local warp; no per-card renderer settings.
coordinateSystem: 488x680, center=(244,340); matrix [a,b,c,d,tx,ty] maps centered source to centered comparison, inverse also stored. Source aspect normalization precedes matrix in one resampling pass.
